title: Helm: charts, values and release versioning

videos.script: By now the shop is a handful of manifests, and every environment wants them slightly different. More copies here, another greeting there, a newer image in staging. {{different}} Copying the files and editing each copy works until somebody fixes one and forgets the others. {{copies}} Helm takes the other road. The manifests become templates, the differences become values, and each install is a release with a numbered history you can roll back. {{helm}} You will write a small chart for the shop from nothing, install it, upgrade it, roll it back, and install it a second time under another name. {{plan}}
